𝐒𝐓𝐀𝐍𝐋𝐄𝐘 𝐊𝐔𝐁𝐑𝐈𝐂𝐊 𝐁𝐀𝐒𝐈𝐂𝐀𝐋𝐋𝐘 𝐏𝐑𝐄𝐃𝐈𝐂𝐓𝐄𝐃 𝐓𝐇𝐄 𝐅𝐔𝐓𝐔𝐑𝐄 𝐁𝐀𝐂𝐊 𝐈𝐍 𝟏𝟗𝟔𝟖⁣⁣ 👀 
⁣⁣
Stanley Kubrick’s 2001: A Space Odyssey stands as a visionary exploration of the potential dangers of advanced AI, long before such systems existed in the real world. HAL 9000 is not just a villain in the narrative, but a broader warning about the risks of developing machines that can think and act independently of their creators. Kubrick’s foresight about the dangers of AI resonates deeply today, as society grapples with the ethical and existential risks posed by increasingly powerful AI systems. 🤖
